title: Battle of Jessore
subtitle: The southwest front opens the road toward Khulna and interior routes.
summary: The Battle of Jessore was a key southwest-front engagement in December 1971. The fall of Pakistani positions around Jessore opened routes toward Khulna and other interior points.
heroTagline: The southwest front opens the road toward Khulna and interior routes.
whyItMatters: Jessore helps explain the military geography of the southwest campaign.
